prompt:
Create a FIRST ART DRAFT of a modular grass-and-rock ELEVATION TILESET for a cartoon front-facing top-down 2.5D game. The attached old tileset is a FUNCTIONAL LAYOUT and CAMERA reference, not a color or pixel-art reference. New art style: smooth hand-painted cartoon, cheerful mid-green turf, soft stylized grey stone, clean dark colored outlines, restrained shading, large readable forms, NOT photorealistic, NOT low-poly, NOT pixel art. Flat top surfaces use simple consistent grass texture. Turf overlaps irregular rock lip naturally. Rock walls have varied chunky irregular rocks, no repeated column pattern. Visible outward-facing front, LEFT and RIGHT cliff walls. No isometric diamond rotation. Consistent orthographic front/elevated camera and upper-left light across every piece.
Output ONE clean wide landscape sprite sheet, 6 equal columns x 4 equal rows, 24 distinct pieces, generous uniform pure green gutters and outer margins, no touching/overlaps, no text or gridlines. Same world scale all pieces. ALL background and empty spaces must be opaque uniform bright chroma green #00FF00, clearly distinct from darker turf.
Rows and columns:
Row1: grass outer northwest corner; straight north turf edge; outer northeast corner; grass straight west edge; PLAIN BORDERLESS SQUARE GRASS CENTER (no rocks, no outline); straight east turf edge.
Row2: grass outer southwest corner; straight south turf edge; outer southeast corner; grass inner northwest concave corner; inner northeast concave corner; inner southwest concave corner.
Row3: grass inner southeast concave corner; FULL-HEIGHT FRONT CLIFF straight segment topped by narrow grass lip; full-height LEFT side cliff segment; full-height RIGHT side cliff segment; front-left cliff convex corner; front-right cliff convex corner.
Row4: alternate front wall rocks A; alternate front wall rocks B; HALF-HEIGHT front wall segment; QUARTER-HEIGHT front wall segment; SMALL HALF-HEIGHT standalone grassy stepping plateau; SMALL QUARTER-HEIGHT standalone grassy stepping plateau.
Full-height wall 96 art units, half height 48, quarter 24: visibly different WALL HEIGHTS, not just overall downscaling. Keep stone detail scale and turf thickness consistent. Center and edge top tiles square in screen-space like reference, not diamond-shaped individual islands. Straight segment boundaries need visually compatible materials and heights, leave cut connecting sides undecorated rather than wrapping a border all around each piece. Only actual exterior edges get turf outlines. No paths, ramps, stairs, flowers, bushes, trees, props, water, cast shadows on background, checkerboard, labels or scenery.
limitations: Grass center is not borderless yet.
Tile boundaries and side-wall orientations need correction before Godot atlas setup.
No atlas regions, collision or terrain connectivity configured.
